annotation.title_clean: European Parliament legislative resolution of 29 April 2021 on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation establishing the Digital Europe Programme
annotation.title_en: European Parliament legislative resolution of 29 April 2021 on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation establishing the Digital Europe Programme
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 506/244
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament second-reading legislative resolution approving the Council's first-reading position on the regulation establishing the Digital Europe Programme and repealing Decision (EU) 2015/2240. It is purely procedural and contains no substantive provisions on AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves the Council position at first reading
Notes the act is adopted in accordance with the Council position
Instructs the President to sign the act with the Council
Instructs forwarding of position to Council, Commission and national parliaments
